description: Upload a PNG and get an artwork id for create_design, with how large it can print. Pass pngUrl (a public HTTPS link; preferred) or pngBase64, not both. A file on the person's computer: ask them to upload it at https://toolboxpod.com/app/library?tab=artwork, then find it with list_artwork.

byteSize.description: Optional check: the file's size in bytes

pngBase64.description: The PNG bytes, base64 (long strings get cut by chat clients: prefer pngUrl)

pngUrl.description: Public HTTPS link to the PNG

name: upload_artwork
title: Upload artwork
